To clarify, I need to provide concrete, observable examples and ask them to reflect on specific situations. This will help distinguish resting (e.g., hand “pill-rolling” while seated) from action/kinetic (e.g., spilling water when pouring) or postural (e.g., holding arms outstretched) tremor — critical for differentiating Parkinson disease (resting-predominant) from essential tremor (action/postural-predominant).
